description: Script audience and consolidation manifest for huaweicloud-skill. It documents who should use each script and identifies consolidation entry points without broadening safety gates.

consolidation_policy.v0_6_action: Document audience boundaries and keep existing script files stable for reviewability.
do_not_do_in_v0_6: Do not merge runtime scripts just to reduce file count.
Do not remove compatibility entry points that existing workflows may call.
Do not broaden planner-only scripts into submit paths.
Do not add ungated Terraform import, drift automation, remote state, or blueprint execution to the default path.

v0_6_x_candidates.candidate: Prefer hcloud_acceptance_closure.py as the user-facing plan/run/evaluate wrapper while preserving probe plan, probe run, and evidence result modules for compatibility and focused tests.
Prefer hcloud_closure_plan.py as the user-facing lifecycle/governance/scenario wrapper while preserving tier-specific planners for compatibility and focused tests.
Wrap build, diff, audit, and smoke utilities behind one maintenance command while preserving current modules.
Keep import/drift/remote-state behind explicit state-change gates and hcloud readback.
Keep qwen_text_to_image.py as a compatibility shim while new model, chat, image, and video helpers use MaaS-named entry points.
Keep probe, readonly planner, and result summarizer separate because they have different data-sensitivity boundaries.

compatibility_retirement_policy.v0_8: Mark compatibility entry points deprecated and keep new docs/routes/examples on unified entry points.
compatibility_retirement_policy.v0_9: Move primary tests to unified entry points; keep only lightweight smoke coverage for compatibility names.
compatibility_retirement_policy.v1_0: Remove or internalize compatibility entry points that have no dedicated user-facing need across two minor releases.

script_groups.audience: agent runtime and user-facing task workflows
script_groups.boundary: May plan or execute only within each script's documented safety gate. Planner-only scripts must stay non-executing.

script_groups.audience: agent runtime for explicit change planning and guarded submit workflows
script_groups.boundary: Use only after context discovery and risk review. Submit still requires the exact command, fresh evidence, and explicit user confirmation.

script_groups.audience: agent runtime only when the primary hcloud path needs local support evidence
script_groups.boundary: Supplement hcloud; do not become a second broad execution plane.

script_groups.audience: skill maintainers and CI-style local checks
script_groups.boundary: Use for catalog, coverage, smoke, Terraform catalog, and promotion maintenance. Do not call these as normal user task answers unless the user is maintaining the skill.

script_groups.audience: imported by other scripts, not direct user entry points
script_groups.boundary: Keep stable APIs for callers and tests; do not document as normal command-line tools.

script_groups.audience: existing workflows that still call legacy names
script_groups.boundary: Keep as compatibility entry points during the v0.8/v0.9 retirement window; prefer unified names in new documentation and remove or internalize stale names for v1.0.

beginner: Explain optional tools by task instead of requiring hcloud, SDK, Terraform, and obsutil all at once.
small_business: Prefer low-cost static-site and Flexus/ECS routing before broad enterprise architecture.
Expose billing readonly and idle candidate review without delete commands.
mid_enterprise: Use inventory, governance closure, observability, and Terraform plan-review assets.
Keep batch mutation and Terraform apply out of the default path until evidence and approvals are explicit.
